text:
ben_support: escalating P1 from support — 'AuroraLabs' pilot can't complete onboarding; SSO fails at token exchange with 403. Renewal checkpoint in ~4 weeks.

olivia_csm: thanks. need short impact for AMs and a customer-facing note. which env? paste error.

ben_support: prod. log: `oauth: token exchange 403 forbidden: invalid audience` — started after yesterday's auth key rotation. Repro with their SAML assertion.

nina_se: likely audience alias mismatch. @ops-bot pull last rotation metadata.

ops-bot: rotation rot-20260310-37 applied 2026-03-10T04:12:23Z. PR https://git.internal/auth-service/pull/462.

olivia_csm: plan: (1) draft customer note with ETA, (2) ops to test rollback in staging, (3) notify AMs about renewal risk. Ben you draft note; Nina run staging test. Carlos loop AM.

ben_support: draft: "Hi <Name>, we're investigating an SSO authentication mismatch affecting pilot users. We're testing a mitigation and expect an update within 90 minutes. We'll follow up at T+60."

olivia_csm: add impact line and offer temporary scoped API keys for immediate access. non-technical phrasing for execs.

nina_se: staging rollback succeeded and restored SSO. plan a 2-min prod rollback. Ops requests CS approval to notify customer of brief interruption.

carlos_am: AM ready to inform customer; they prefer immediate fix. approve rollback.

ben_support: executing prod rollback now.

ops-bot: rollback job started 2026-03-11T15:45:03Z id=99312

ben_support: prod back to green; SSO validated and customer confirmed access.

olivia_csm: next steps: postmortem (nina_se), AM one-pager (carlos_am), update onboarding runbook with SSO quick-check (olivia_csm). Ben open follow-up ticket for certificate rotation QA.

ben_support: ticket CSUP-8899 opened "AuroraLabs SSO 403 after key rotate".

olivia_csm: closing thread — will schedule postmortem and share AM note when ready.
